lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Great work on the mission.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: After analyzing the combat data you submitted, and the investigation data from the Unlimited Squad,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: we've confirmed that the Predator is a new type of Rapture which we have no previous records of.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Also, the bite mark left on Black Smith from before,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: it was their doing, as we suspected.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I figured as much.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: However, upon your return from the snowfields,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: there has been no sighting in that region or anywhere near the Ark,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: of anything which feeds on cores and grows,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: or anything which utilizes optical camouflage.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That means they must have migrated here for some unknown reason, even though their natural habitat is far from the Ark.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That could also suggest that they're a mutation of some kind created through a Rapture evolutionary process we don't yet understand.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There is that possibility.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: As for the bunker that they used as a base,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: the Unlimited Squad found a similarly designed bunker not far from it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: There are more of these bunkers?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Yes, but their design doesn't correspond with anything that we have on record.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That means...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Is it possible that someone other than those from the Ark created it?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: That is a distinct possibility, yes.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There is a possibility that someone may not even be human.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Moving forward, the Unlimited Squad and The Scouts will be cooperating to investigate further,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: so we will have to wait and see.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Even The Scouts are being assigned?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: They said they were thankful for your help, and felt bad about requiring assistance.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Therefore, to further hone their reconnaissance skills,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: they volunteered to focus on surface exploration for a while.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: By the way.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Do you remember the mass-produced Nikke squad you met last time?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... I do. Why?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: No changes were made to the squad members

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: but they've apparently borrowed a space in Elysion Tower, and are training there now.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Training for?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Their purported goal is to take down Black Smith on their own someday.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Dreaming big, I see.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: According to their commander, someone apparently lit a real fire underneath him.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Well, it wasn't me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... I guess he's not a complete idiot after all.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Well, that's all I have to say about this mission.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: One thing is for certain; we're dealing with more unknown factors than we were before.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You did well going up against an unfamiliar foe.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: The surface has always been that way.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: A place swarming with unknown enemies.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: This was merely the latest in the long list of threats out there.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Heh, is that so?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You look relieved.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: A little.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: So, did you find the answer to your question from before?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Are you still wondering if you could take down Behemoth without the Counters?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That was never a question to begin with.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We will win no matter what.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: If we can't win at first, we'll keep fighting until we do.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That's all there is to it.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Haha, is that so.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I'm glad you managed to find an answer.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Well then, get some rest.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: Of all things, why would you pick this...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Wow, you're so pretty, Eunhwa!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Can I take a ph-photo?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: Both of you, shut up!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hehe, is there any c-chance you could wear this for the whole day?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: You want me to walk around wearing this?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: What about you two?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: The chest area was a bit tight for mine, so I sent it in for alterations. It'll be here next week.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: M-mine's being delivered to the dorm tomorrow in my chosen color.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: Well then, I'm not gonna—

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: But y-you look so pretty in it...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: You never wear r-regular clothes anymore. Wh-who knows when you'll wear something like this again?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Can't you w-wear it, just for today?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: *Sigh...*

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: Fine. I'll wear it. Satisfied?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: R-really?!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: So, where to next?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: We're g-going to the Toy Store!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: The Toy Store? What are you going to buy there?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: It's fun to just look around!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: Looking at toys... what are you, a child?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Come now, Eunhwa, if Vesti wants to go to the Toy Store, that's perfectly fine.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Belorta and Mica also said they had a surprise for me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: *Sigh...*

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: Fine. Let's go...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe! Off we go!
The group heads to the Toy Store.
*Pop*
A black cat pops out of the gift box Vesti is holding.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hehe! Did that s-scare you?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: ... Was it supposed to?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It certainly gave me a fright!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Is this what you wanted to buy?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yeah! W-watch, there's more it can do!
Vesti presses the button on the box.
*Meow* *Meoooow*
As music plays, the cat begins to dance with a blank expression.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my, it even dances?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Isn't it a-adorable?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: That thing...?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, it's so cute. Actually, it reminds me of someone...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hehe. It d-does, doesn't it...?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: What are you two blabbering about?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: If you're finished looking around, let's get out of here. This outfit is super uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Come on, Eunhwa, don't be like that. Why don't you pick out something for yourself?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: No.
The group heads to the cafe to indulge in a parfait.

lines.speaker: womanstaff
lines.text: Your parfait is ready.
A massive, lavishly decorated parfait is placed in the center of the table.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Wow, it's so big! And so pretty!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: Are the three of us meant to eat this entire thing?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yep!
Eunhwa stares silently at the parfait.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: ... There's no way.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe. Why not? I think we can do it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: I think it's going to be too sweet for me—
*Click*

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: What the heck?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hehe, it's j-just... I've been wanting to come here as a group for so long, I w-wanted to capture the moment for posterity.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: Fine. Take all the pictures you want.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: R-really? Can I?!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: But in return,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: I get to change out of this ridiculous outfit.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: B-but you said you'd wear it for th-the whole day...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: I feel like a clown, and the circus ends here.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: I'm changing.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: O-okay...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: All right, everyone, let's settle down and try some of this parfait.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's absolutely scrumptious.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I have heard amazing things about the parfait here!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: T-try some, Eunhwa!
Eunhwa picks up one of the cookies stuck into the parfait.
*Crunch*

lines.speaker: eunhwa_c
lines.text: ... It's not bad.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hehe, so y-you like it?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Vesti, how about a photo of the three of us?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Why don't we ask the staff to take the picture?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: O-okay! Great idea!
The three members of Absolute spend some time together.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Ahh, this is much more comfortable.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Th-that other outfit was so pretty though... what a p-pity...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Enough. Just tell me what you want to do next.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Next up was a... pajama party, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: That's right! W-we can head back to the dorm and have a pajama party!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You want me to change again?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Yep! Vesti and I picked out something absolutely lovely at the mall earlier.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: D-don't worry, this time, we'll all be getting changed.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: *Sigh*... All right, fine.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: S-so you're going to join us?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Unless you don't want me to.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: N-no! O-of course not!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: U-uh, Eunhwa...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Wh-why are you being so accommodating?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Do you not want me to be?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: N-no, it's not that!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I was just c-curious, that's all.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Y-you're being way nicer to me than usual...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Tch. You ask way too many questions.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: S-sorry...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: *Sigh...*

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Because... last time...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: H-huh?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I can't hear you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Then forget it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I won't repeat myself.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: P-please, can you say it one m-more time? Pleaaaase?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Now stop pestering me, or I'm not joining this ridiculous pajama party.
Eunhwa and Vesti squabble back and forth as they walk ahead.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe. Oh, Eunhwa...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You're terrible at speaking from the heart!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: *Sigh...*

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Because I was sorry... for what happened last time.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I was wondering how you two would ever make up...
Emma looks at Eunhwa and Vesti from behind.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe. Thank goodness it worked out.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Emma!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hmm?
Eunhwa turns around and looks at Emma.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What are you doing back there by yourself?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Emma...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Don't change.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Never change.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: ... I guess you're really okay now.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Emma...?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Em-Emma? Is something the matter?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Haha, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'm coming!
Emma runs toward Eunhwa and Vesti.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hmm... It's been a while! Shall I make something tasty for the both of you?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Er... th-that's okay!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... I'll handle the cooking.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Whoa, r-really? You're gonna c-cook, Eunhwa...?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my, Eunhwa is going to cook? Would you like me to help out?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: No. I'll do it myself.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I-I think that would be better too!
The three members of Absolute talk as they walk forward,
no longer stopping or turning to look back.
Side by side, they walked forward into the future.
ABSOLUTE DAYS: AND
